settings.body: Ordered this as a surprise for my dad, a lifelong football fan. The size and finish are stunning, and engraving our family name on it made it really personal. It now has pride of place in his study.

settings.hero_desc: An oversized replica of a perfume bottle - textured body, gold cap and branded base - built at statement scale for retail displays, launches and brand activations. We reproduce any bottle, larger than life.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your bottle, colours, branding and scale
settings.s1_body: A product launch deserves a centrepiece. We recreate your perfume bottle as an oversized sculpture - faithful to its shape, texture, cap and colours, scaled up to command attention in a store window, on a counter or at an event. Produced as a single hero piece or a coordinated set of your range.
settings.case_body: Built for Ahmed Perfumes launch, these oversized bottle replicas became the hero of the display - faithful to the real product but at statement scale, drawing shoppers in and anchoring the campaign.
settings.case_quote: The giant bottles stole the show at our launch. Influencers came over just to photograph them.
settings.prov_p: An oversized replica turns a shelf item into a landmark. It gives a launch its centrepiece and a store its photo moment.
